item.name: Introduction
Domain - Url
item.description:
*   In edmingle when you create your institute edmingle will create one apiurl for you that is only point your institution.
*   How to Get ApiURL?
    *   You need to Contact Our support team for ApiUrl our support team will share it with you and you just need to update that url in our postman collection variables.

item.name: InstitutionId
item.description:
*   When you Singup in edmingle It will create one institution For you and it's having their own website and other features.
*   inside one institution you can create mulitple organization based on your requirements.
*   You can contact our support team For getting your institution Id.
*   Set this in value in our collection variables so it will update that value in every request.

item.name: Organization Id
item.description:
*   In Edmingle, your business is termed as an organization. If you have multiple businesses, you simply set each of those up as an individual organization. Each organization is an independent Edmingle Organization with it’s own organization ID, base currency, time zone, reports, etc.
*   The parameter ORGID along with the organization ID should be sent in with every API request to identify the organization.
*   If you obtain **domain-Url** and **InstitutionId** call our Meta->Organization Details Api it will give you organization list that you have in your institution.

item.name: Host Name
item.description:
*   HostName Refers to Your Domain Which you are using. Using your hostname and our institution Meta details api you can get information about institution.
*   How to Get Host Name?
    *   Get Your HomePage Url
    *   Remove http:// or https:// from that Url
    *   Now put this value in collection variables name as hostname
    *   Example:-
        *   HomePage Url :- [https://demoacademy.edmingle.com/](https://demoacademy.edmingle.com/)
        *   Hostname:-  
            [demoacademy.edmingle.com](https://demoacademy.edmingle.com/)

*   The Edmingle API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
*   Edmingle API is built using REST principles which ensures predictable URLs that makes writing applications easy. This API follows HTTP rules, enabling a wide range of HTTP clients can be used to interact with the API.

API Key Validity Documentation

## Overview

This document outlines the validity duration of API keys and the conditions under which the validity period is determined. API keys are essential for accessing and utilizing services provided by our API.

## API Key Validity

### 1\. **Persistent Login**

If a user opts for persistent login during API key generation, the API key remains valid for a duration of 30 days from the last login. Persistent login allows users to maintain access to the API without the need for frequent reauthentication.

### 2\. Non-Persistent Login

For users who do not choose persistent login, the API key is valid for a shorter duration of 5 hours from the time of login. Non-persistent login is suitable for scenarios where security is a top priority, and frequent reauthentication is preferred.

## Renewal and Refresh

### 1\. Persistent Login

For users with persistent login, the API key's validity is automatically extended to 30 days with each successful login within the existing session.

### 2\. Non-Persistent Login

To continue using the API after the initial 5-hour validity period for non-persistent login, users must log in again to obtain a new API key.

## Security Considerations

To ensure the security of API access, users are encouraged to choose authentication settings based on their specific needs. Persistent login is convenient for scenarios where continuous access is required, while non-persistent login is suitable for cases where security is a higher priority than convenience.

## Conclusion

Understanding the validity conditions of API keys is crucial for effective and secure utilization of our services. Users are advised to choose the appropriate login settings based on their use case and security requirements. If you have any further questions or concerns, please contact our support team.

item.name: Error Codes
item.description:
| Error Codes | Message | Description | Solution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 400/401 | Bad Request/Unauthorized | The request was invalid or cannot be processed.Authentication is required or failed. | Ensure all required parameters are present and correctly formatted.Verify the API key or authentication token. |
| 403 | Forbidden | The server understood the request, but refuses to authorize it. | Ensure proper permissions for the requested resource. |
| 404 | Not Found | The requested resource was not found on the server. | Check the request URL and ensure the resource exists. |
| 429 | Too Many Requests | The user has sent too many requests in a given time frame. | Implement rate limiting, slow down request rate, and retry later. |
| 500 | Internal Server Error | The server encountered an unexpected condition. | Try the request again later or contact support if the issue persists. |
| 502 | Bad Gateway | The server received an invalid response from the upstream server. | Retry after a few moments or report the issue. |
| 503 | Service Unavailable | The server is currently unable to handle the request. | Retry after a few moments or check the server status. |
| 504 | Gateway Timeout | The server, while acting as a gateway, timed out waiting for a response. | Ensure the backend service is responsive, or retry later. |

| 3 | start_time (in minutes) |
| 4 | end_time (in minutes) |
| 5 | constant value -1 |
| 6 | constant value "" |
| 7 | signin_status ( 0 - Not Signed , 1 - SignedIn , 3 - Canclled, 5 - Miss SignedIn (Some other tutors signed)) |
| 8 | signin_time (Unix timestamp) |
| 9 | class_id |
| 10 | class_name |
| 11 | tutor_id |
| 12 | organization_id |
| 13 | tutor_name |
| 14 | master_batch_id |
| 15 | master_batch_name |
| 16 | individual_batch_attendance |
| 17 | is_live (0 - Offline Class , 1 - Live Class Not Started, 2 - Live Class Running, 3 - Live Class Ended) |
| 18 | topics_taught |
| 19 | topics_taught_ids |
| 20 | class_type (0 - Normal Class, 1 - Exam Class , 2 - Extra Class, 3 - Merged batch class session) |
| 21 | external_class_link |
| 22 | homework |

| **Node Name** | **Type** | **Required** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tutor_id | Integer | Yes | Class tutor Id |
| is_live | Boolean | Yes | 0 And True |
| zoom_room_waiting | Boolean | Yes | Zoom Room Waiting |
| class_date | Date(DD-MM-YYYY) | Yes | Date Format Example (01 Jul 2022) |
| s_hour | Integer | Yes | start Hour - Hours By Day For example if it is 5Pm on day then value is 17 and if 5AM on day then value of 5. |
| s_minute | Integer | Yes | Start minitue - minitues value should be 0 to 60 |
| e_hour |  |  | End Hour - Hours By Day For example if it is 5Pm on day then value is 17 and if 5AM on day then value of 5. |
| e_minute | Integer | Yes | End minitue - minitues value should be 0 to 60 |
| send_sms | Boolean | Yes | 1 Or 0 |
| new_class_id | Integer | Yes | Main Class Id |
| attendance_id | Integer | Yes | That Day Class Id |
| topics | String | Yes | Comments |

request.description:
To get Student Enrollment Details Use This Api  
[https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/11192156/UzQvsQWi#5c0ccf23-1697-4d6b-81f6-d62cff1f3d2b](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/11192156/UzQvsQWi#5c0ccf23-1697-4d6b-81f6-d62cff1f3d2b)

This endpoint retrieves a list of bundles based on the provided organization ID, with optional pagination parameters for page number and items per page.

### Request Parameters

- `organization_id` (query parameter) - The ID of the organization for which the bundles are being retrieved.
- `page` (query parameter) - The page number for paginated results.
- `per_page` (query parameter) - The number of items to be included per page.
    

### Response

Upon a successful execution, the server returns a JSON object with a status code of 200 and the following structure:

- `code` - The status code of the response.
- `message` - A message related to the response, if any.
- `bundle` - An array of bundles containing bundle details such as ID, name, description, course IDs, display index, pretty name, package type, test series indicator, image URL, course type, archive status, and accreditation information.
- `page_context` - Pagination context including page number, items per page, indicator for more pages, and total number of rows.
    

### Example Response

``` json
{
    "code": 0,
    "message": "",
    "bundle": [
        {
            "bundle_id": 0,
            "bundle_name": "",
            "bundle_description": "",
            "course_ids": [""],
            "display_index": 0,
            "pretty_name": "",
            "is_online_package": 0,
            "is_test_series": 0,
            "img_url": "",
            "course_type": 0,
            "is_archived": 0,
            "is_woolf_accredited": null,
            "course_bundle_organization_ids": [""]
        }
    ],
    "page_context": {
        "page": 0,
        "per_page": 0,
        "has_more_page": true,
        "total_rows": 0
    }
}

 ```

request.description:
This documentation describes the `field_type` values and their corresponding descriptions for use in API requests.

#### Field Types

The following `field_type` values are supported:

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `1` | Single choice field: A field where a user can select only one option from a list. |
| `2` | Multiple choice field: A field where a user can select multiple options from a list. |
| `3` | Star rating field: A field for collecting feedback or ratings using stars. |
| `4` | Linear scale field: A field for collecting ratings on a continuous scale. |
| `5` | Date field: A field for capturing dates. |
| `6` | Number field: A field for collecting numeric input. |
| `7` | Short answer field: A field for capturing concise textual responses. |
| `8` | Long answer field: A field for capturing detailed textual responses. |

# Join Live Class
This endpoint allows users to join a live class using the provided attendance ID.

## Request
- Method: POST
- URL: {{domain-url}}liveclass/join/<attendanceId>

## Response
- Status: 200
- Content-Type: application/json

Example response body:
```json
{
    "code": 0,
    "message": "",
    "meeting_password": "",
    "join_id": "",
    "meeting_id": 0,
    "join_url": "",
    "api_key": "",
    "sdk_key": "",
    "sdk_jwt_key": "",
    "signature": ""
}
```

About the event 

Nama-Ramayana is the story of Lord Rama used for the purpose of mediating on the name of Lord Rama through Ramayana. It consists of 108 simple Sanskrit verses which describe the most important events portrayed in Valmiki Ramayana. Like Valmiki Ramayana, this also is divided into 7 kanda-s. Lakshman Raghuram. 

We humbly invite all devotees to utilize this opportunity to be blessed by the grace of Bhagavan Rama. You can participate in the parayana and accrue Punya by Shravana (Listening) and Parayana (Chanting). Please join us in this prayer for lokakshema, from the safety and comfort of your home.

This endpoint is used to send a one-time password (OTP) to the user. The request should be sent as an HTTP POST to {{domain-url}}user/otp with a form-data request body type. The payload should include a JSONString parameter with a type of text.

### Request Body

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JSONString | text | Specifies the type of the OTP. |
